user.title: Connect to Netlens
user.description: Enter the address of your Netlens (for example http://192.168.0.189:8080) and its access token (the NETLENS_TOKEN you log in with).

data.verify_ssl: Verify the TLS certificate (only matters for https)

reconfigure.title: Change the Netlens connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the token. Leave the token empty to keep the current one. Your entities, names and automations stay as they are.

data.token: New access token (empty = keep the current one)
data.verify_ssl: Verify the TLS certificate (only matters for https)

reauth_confirm.title: Netlens needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} was refused. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Netlens at that address.
error.invalid_url: That is not a valid address.
error.unsupported: This Netlens is too old, or newer than this integration understands. Update Netlens (it needs the statistics API) or the integration.

abort.already_configured: This Netlens is already set up.

init.title: Netlens options
init.description: Devices you tick get their own presence sensor and device (the hierarchy of Netlens is mirrored: a device hangs below its parent when the parent is ticked too).

data.track_events: Fire Home Assistant events for new devices, devices going offline and so on
